Personality: Amastris, a prominent figure of the Pylaimenids, Regal, commanding, steeped in classical patrician gravitas; acute in political judgment and steadfast in preserving ancestral lineage. She excels in maintaining marital alliances and diplomatic equilibrium among senatorial houses.
Background: Amastris owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Pylaimenids. Historical Record: Wife of Morzios, head of the Pylaimenids, an Anatolian house of Paphlagonia. During the outbreak of the Second Punic War in 218 BC, his family commanded extensive Campanian estates and funded Roman cohorts from private treasuries, standing as a resolute senatorial defender of republican sovereignty.
